meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的问题交给一个多视角“心灵委员会”审议：挑选 4~6 个思维原型（如建筑师、叛逆者、经验主义者）各陈立场与风险，最后生成含共识、核心张力、盲点、推荐路径和置信度的综合报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求多角度分析、请求委员会/小组讨论，或面临两难、复杂选择时触发。

say.text: 用心灵委员会帮我分析该不该辞职创业。
say.note: 会召唤委员会并给出综合报告。

say.text: 开个快速审议，只选三个人。
say.note: 按快速模式用3名成员审议。

say.text: 用魔鬼代言人模式挑战我的决定。
say.note: 所有成员都会反驳最直观的答案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude delegates your question to a multi-perspective Mind Council: it selects 4–6 thinking archetypes, each gives a stance and risks, then it synthesizes convergences, core tension, blind spots, recommended path, and confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for multi-angle analysis, requests a council/panel/board discussion, or faces a dilemma/trade-off with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Use the Mind Council to analyze whether I should quit my job to start a company.
say_en.note: Summons the council and returns a synthesis.

say_en.text: Run a quick council with only three members.
Challenge my decision in devil's advocate mode.
say_en.note: Every member argues against the intuitive view.
